text:
maria: heads-up — got an escalation from a support engineer: multiple customers reporting 502/504s and timeouts from hosted inference in us-west starting ~10:22 UTC. one customer (AcmeCorp) also says they saw doubled billing events for the same request. filing here to triage quickly.

alex: oncall, can you confirm if there's an ongoing deploy or config change around 10:20-10:30?

oncall: no planned deploys in that window. noticing elevated 502 rates from gateway-proxy cluster gw-us-west-1 from 10:21 -> 10:36. spike in upstream 5xx from inference-service.

sam: grabbing logs from the gateway now. also pulling route-level metrics.

julia: support-bot forwarded the customer repro payload for AcmeCorp, looks like a long-stream generation (~15k tokens) that timed out mid-stream. they retried and got another 502, then a billing webhook fired twice.

alex: can you paste the gateway error traces?

sam: logs snippet: ```
2026-03-17T10:22:14.512Z gw-us-west-1 proxy: upstream response 502 (upstream: inference-svc-01) request_id=abc123 route=/v1/generate latency_ms=12045
2026-03-17T10:22:15.104Z gw-us-west-1 proxy: upstream response 504 (upstream: inference-svc-02) request_id=def456 route=/v1/generate latency_ms=30001
```

maria: looks like some long-tail requests exceeded the gateway deadline then upstream returned 5xx. could be kv-cache pressure or instance OOM. sam, any OOMs?

sam: checking node metrics — no OOMs, but inference-svc pods show high connection queue depth and persistent worker threads at 100% for a few instances around 10:20-10:30. suspect slow tokenization or a background GC pause on python runtime for that model.

julia: customer repro curl (sanitized): ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" -d '{"model":"rwd/gpt-large","input":"<long prompt>","max_tokens":15000,"stream":true}'
```

maria: note our hosted default request timeout is 30s at the gateway layer. streaming requests that produce long compute can hit that if model latency is high.

alex: about doubled billing events — billing webhook is emitted on request completion + on gateway timeout fallback we may have a retry path that still charges usage when backend is slow. julia, any evidence of duplicate request_ids?

julia: yes: request_id abc123 retried by client after 502, but gateway emitted a partial-charge webhook when timeout occurred and then a final-charge when backend eventually returned 200 on retry. we need to update dedupe logic for billing webhooks so partial/timeouts don't cause duplicate billing.

oncall: immediate mitigations: 1) increase gateway timeout for streaming/gen routes to 60s in us-west for the next 30m to drain backlog. 2) add temporary circuit-break on model rwd/gpt-large for very long token requests (reject >10k tokens with 429). 3) throttle concurrent streams per-customer to 4. anyone object?

alex: +1 do it. sam, can you roll the timeout config to gw-us-west-1 and add the circuit-break rule?

sam: applying config now via infra-runner: `infra-runner apply gw-timeout-us-west` — pushing patch. will monitor.

ops-bot: deploy started by sam at 10:40 UTC: infra-runner/gw-timeout-us-west v2 -> monitoring.

maria: support: notify AcmeCorp that we're investigating, temporary mitigation planned (increasing timeout and limiting huge generations), ask them to hold retries for 10 minutes. also open billing support ticket and pause auto-charges for affected request IDs.

julia: created billing ticket #B-8842 and flagged payment ops to review duplicate webhooks.

oncall: monitoring shows gateway 5xx rate down to baseline after 10:46. inference worker CPU still elevated on two instances — scheduling a rolling restart for those pods to clear any stuck threads. sam to handle.

sam: rolling restart launched at 10:52. will post status.

maria: action items for post-incident: - short-term (next 48h): 1) patch gateway billing webhook dedupe (ensure idempotency key from request_id) 2) add request-size guardrails & better customer-facing 4xx message for long streams 3) update runbook for stream timeout vs billing semantics. - long-term (2-4 weeks): 1) investigate model runtime GC/slow-paths for rwd/gpt-large 2) improve streaming progress heartbeats so gateway doesn't prematurely timeout 3) quota & backpressure improvements per-customer.

alex: assigning: billing dedupe -> julia, runbook+guardrails -> maria + support, model perf -> research (sam to coordinate), heartbeat design -> eng-runtime (alex).

julia: noted and will drive billing patch.

sam: restart complete at 11:04, worker CPU back to normal, no new 5xx spikes.

maria: support updated AcmeCorp and paused billing for the two duplicated charges. customer is appreciative, asked for postmortem and timeline.

oncall: closing triage channel here. we'll schedule a 30m postmortem sync at 15:00 UTC to go over root cause and owners for the 48h/2-4w items.

alex: thanks team. please add meeting notes + timeline to the incident doc after the postmortem. :thumbsup:
